first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A short-haired adult man wearing a near-black suit jacket, white shirt, and dark tie, initially positioned between the wooden posts and looking up toward the upper right, then shown from the side and back in the final portion.

entities.name: Brick-and-stone wall
entities.identification: The light-gray to grayish-brown brick-and-stone wall behind Person A and the Wooden post-and-beam frame, with a rough, uneven surface.

entities.name: Wooden post-and-beam frame
entities.identification: A staircase-related structure composed of thick vertical wooden posts, horizontal components, and a long strip-like component inclined toward the upper right.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: Person B, wearing a gray knee-length skirt, on the flight of stairs above and to the right of Person A. In this segment, Person B is partially visible along the upper edge starting from frame 33 and corresponds continuously to the person ascending the steps in the opening portion of cp010.

entities.name: Window opening in the wall
entities.identification: A wall opening partially visible along the upper-right edge in the latter portion, with a light-colored edge visible and occluded by wooden components and cropped by the frame.

entities.name: Blue-and-white bright area outside the window
entities.identification: A white to pale-blue highlighted area partially visible behind the opening along the upper-right edge.
